title: Political Economics of Marxism and Leninism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical value labor theory of Karl Marx through basic concepts such as goods, money, prices, laws of value, dual nature of productive labor, labor productivity, etc.
Understand the theoretical surplus value production of Karl Marx under conditions of free market competition capitalism
Understand the monopoly and state monopoly theory in a capitalist market economy
Understand the basic knowledge about the socialist-oriented market economy in Vietnam and the economic interest relations within it
Develop skills to protect legitimate interests, solve problems scientifically based on evidence when starting a business or participating in economic-social activities
Form critical thinking skills to apply foundational theories to solve economic issues when participating in economic-social relationships
Possess the ability to self-study and accumulate experience to improve professional competence
Become a global citizen, ready to take positive action to demonstrate social responsibility
